meanings.usage: 既可以指人犯了罪，也可以指人因为做错事而感到愧疚
常搭配介词towards/of，表示对某事物/某人宽容
海关场景中特指申报需缴税的物品，也可用于正式宣布决定、消息等

meanings.meaning: hardened的动词harden意为变硬（常修饰有多年不良经历、已经习以为常的人，如hardened criminal（惯犯））

meanings.usage: 对应动词smuggle，意为走私、偷运

meanings.meaning: 爱指手画脚的，好管闲事的
meanings.usage: 多含贬义，形容人过度行使权力、多管闲事
修饰动词，表示做某事时的状态很自信，对应形容词confident
口语中常用来形容事物质量差、情况很糟糕
常搭配介词on/upon，指突然抓住机会或者扑向某物/某人
修饰说话的语气，对应形容词sarcastic
常搭配介词from，表示免除某项义务、税费等

meanings.meaning: 责任，义务（海关场景中特指进口/出口关税，常见搭配import duty（进口税））

meanings.usage: 这里hair gel指发胶，也可作动词表示胶凝、成型

meanings.meaning: 拧开，旋开（前缀un-表示反义，对应动词screw（拧紧））

meanings.usage: 通常用复数形式nostrils表示两个鼻孔

phrases.usage: 海关场景专有名词，指无需申报物品的旅客通行的“绿色通道”

examples.en: If you have nothing to declare, you can take the Green Channel.
examples.zh: 如果你没有需要申报的物品，你可以走绿色通道。

phrases.usage: 表示直视某人的眼睛，通常用于坦诚、问心无愧的场景

examples.en: He lied to me and couldn't look me in the eye when he spoke.
examples.zh: 他对我撒了谎，说话的时候不敢直视我的眼睛。

phrases.usage: 此处含义是“仔细检查”，还有“经历、度过”的含义

examples.en: The police went through all the evidence to find the truth.
examples.zh: 警方仔细检查了所有证据来找出真相。

phrases.usage: 形容东西乱作一团，或者情况非常糟糕

examples.en: After the party, the whole house was in a dreadful mess.
examples.zh: 派对结束后，整栋房子乱得一塌糊涂。

phrases.usage: 此处指“（脸上）流露出喜悦、兴奋的神情”，还有“点亮、开灯”的含义

examples.en: Her face lit up when she received the admission letter.
examples.zh: 收到录取通知书的时候，她脸上露出了喜色。

phrases.usage: 指猛抓住某物，或者突然指出别人的错误、抓住机会

examples.en: The reporter pounced on the politician's slip of the tongue.
examples.zh: 记者立刻抓住了政客的口误进行追问。

phrases.usage: 表示免除某责任、义务或费用

examples.en: Students are exempt from the entrance fee for the museum.
examples.zh: 学生可以免除这家博物馆的门票费用。

phrases.usage: 专有名词，指进口商品需要缴纳的进口税

examples.en: You have to pay import duty on luxury goods brought from abroad.
examples.zh: 你从国外带回的奢侈品需要缴纳进口税。

grammar.title: should have done 结构
grammar.structure: should + have + 动词过去分词
grammar.definition: 表示“本应该做某事（实际上没做）”，属于虚拟语气的一种，常用来表达责备、后悔、建议等语气 用于谈论过去本该发生却没有发生的情况，否定形式为should not have done，表“本不该做某事却做了”

examples.zh: 你本应该申报那个（物品）的。

examples.en: You should have told me the news earlier.
examples.zh: 你本应该早点告诉我这个消息的。

examples.en: We shouldn't have spent so much money on unnecessary things.
examples.zh: 我们本不该在不必要的东西上花这么多钱的。

grammar.title: 过去分词作定语
grammar.structure: 及物动词过去分词 + 名词 / 名词 + 过去分词（短语）
grammar.definition: 过去分词可以放在名词前面或后面作定语，表被动或者完成的含义 单个过去分词一般放在被修饰名词前，过去分词短语作定语则放在被修饰名词后，相当于一个被动语态的定语从句

examples.en: even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
examples.zh: 即便他的手提箱里藏着500块金表。

examples.en: The book written by my favorite author sold very well.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的作家写的那本书销量非常好。

examples.en: We need to fix the broken window before it rains.
examples.zh: 下雨前我们得把那扇碎了的窗户修好。

original.en: The hardened professional smuggler, on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings.
original.zh: 而另一方面，老练的职业走私犯却从来不会被这种情绪困扰。

imitations.en: Many people enjoy living in big cities. Small towns, on the other hand, are more suitable for people who love quiet life.
imitations.zh: 很多人喜欢在大城市生活，而另一方面，小城镇更适合喜爱安静生活的人。

imitations.en: Online learning is very convenient. Traditional classroom education, on the other hand, allows better interaction between teachers and students.
imitations.zh: 线上学习非常方便，而另一方面，传统课堂教育能让师生有更好的互动。

original.zh: 麻烦你打开这个手提箱好吗？

imitations.en: Would you mind passing me the salt on the table please?
imitations.zh: 麻烦你把桌子上的盐递给我好吗？

imitations.zh: 我打开面包店的门时，扑面而来的是新鲜面包温暖的香气。

imitations.zh: 游客们走进森林时，耳边首先传来了鸟儿动听的歌声。

lines.en: Customs Officers are quite tolerant these days, but they can still stop you when you are going through the Green Channel and have nothing to declare.
lines.zh: 现在的海关官员往往相当宽容。

lines.en: Even really honest people are often made to feel guilty.
lines.zh: 但是，当你通过绿色通道，没有任何东西需要申报时，他们仍可以拦住你。

lines.en: The hardened professional smuggler , on the other hand, is never troubled by such feelings, even if he has five hundred gold watches hidden in his suitcase.
lines.zh: 甚至是最诚实的人也常弄得觉得有罪似的，而老练的职业走私犯却使手提箱里藏着500只金表，却也处之泰然。

lines.en: When I returned form abroad recently, a particularly officious young Customs Officer clearly regarded me as a smuggler. 'Have you anything to declare?
lines.zh: 最近一次，我也出国归来，碰上一位特别好管闲事的年轻海关官员，他显然把我当成走私犯。

lines.en: he asked, looking me in the eye.
lines.zh: “您有什么需要申报的吗？

lines.en: 'No', I answered confidently.
lines.zh: ”他直盯着我的眼睛问。

lines.en: 'Would you mind unlocking this suitcase please?
lines.zh: “没有。

lines.en: 'Not at all,' I answered.
lines.zh: ”我自信地回答说。

lines.en: The Officer went through the case with great care.
lines.zh: “请打开这只手提箱好吗？

lines.en: All the thing I had packed so carefully were soon in a dreadful mess.
lines.zh: ”“好的。

lines.en: I felt sure I would never be able to close the case again.
lines.zh: ”我回答说。

lines.en: Suddenly, I saw the Officer's face light up.
lines.zh: 那位官员十分仔细地把箱子检查了一遍。

lines.en: He had spotted a tiny bottle at the bottom of my case and he pounced on it with delight.
lines.zh: 所有细心包装好的东西一会儿工夫就乱成一团。

lines.en: 'Perfume, eh?
lines.zh: 我相信那箱子再也关不上了。

lines.en: he asked sarcastically .
lines.zh: 突然，我看到官员脸上露出了得意的神色。

lines.en: 'You should have declared that.
lines.zh: 他在我的箱底发现了一只小瓶，高兴地一把抓了起来。

lines.en: Perfume is not exempt from import duty.
lines.zh: “香水，嗯？

lines.en: 'But it isn't perfume,' I said.
lines.zh: ”他讥讽地说道，“你刚才应该申报，香水要上进口税的。

lines.en: 'It's hair gel.
lines.zh: ”“不，这不是香水，”我说，“是发胶。

lines.en: Then I added with a smile, 'It's a strange mixture I make myself. As I expected, he did not believe me.
lines.zh: ”接着我脸带微笑补充说：“这是一种我自己配制的奇特的混合物。

lines.en: 'Try it!
lines.zh: ”“你就闻一闻吧！

lines.zh: 一股怪味袭来，使他相信了我说的真话。

questions.q: What was the Customs Officer looking for?
questions.zh: 那位海关官员当时在找什么？
questions.a: He was looking for anything that should have been declared — dutiable goods that a traveller might be smuggling through the Green Channel. He suspected the writer, searched his case and eagerly pounced on a tiny bottle which he took to be perfume.
questions.aZh: 他在找应该申报而未申报的东西，即旅客可能经绿色通道偷带的征税物品。他怀疑作者，翻查箱子，并得意地抓起一只他认定是香水的小瓶。
questions.hint: 答案出自第1段 nothing to declare 以及官员发现小瓶后说的“Perfume, eh?”

questions.q: Why does the writer say that even really honest people are often made to feel guilty?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说，即使真正诚实的人也常被弄得觉得自己有罪？
questions.a: Because Customs Officers, though tolerant, can still stop travellers who are going through the Green Channel with nothing to declare and search them. Innocent people are made to feel like smugglers.
questions.aZh: 因为海关官员虽宽容，仍可以拦住经绿色通道、没有东西申报的旅客并对其检查，使清白的人觉得自己像走私犯。
questions.hint: 见课文第1、2句：stop you … and even really honest people are often made to feel guilty

questions.q: What happened to the things the writer had packed so carefully?
questions.zh: 作者细心包装好的那些东西后来怎么样了？
questions.a: After the officer went through the case with great care, everything was soon in a dreadful mess, and the writer felt sure he would never be able to close the case again.
questions.aZh: 官员十分仔细地检查过箱子后，所有东西很快乱成一团，作者确信箱子再也关不上了。
questions.hint: 见课文第9—11句：in a dreadful mess / never be able to close the case again

questions.q: What was in the tiny bottle, and how did the writer prove it?
questions.zh: 那只小瓶里装的到底是什么？作者又是怎样证明的？
questions.a: It was not perfume but hair gel — a strange mixture the writer had made himself. He asked the officer to smell it, and an unpleasant smell convinced the officer that he was telling the truth.
questions.aZh: 那并非香水，而是发胶，是作者自己配制的一种奇特混合物。他请官员闻一闻，一股怪味使官员相信他说的是真话。
questions.hint: 见课文：It's hair gel … a strange mixture I make myself 与 an unpleasant smell which convinced him

questions.q: Why does the writer call the chalk marks on his baggage “precious”?
questions.zh: 作者为什么把行李上的粉笔记号称作“宝贵的”？
questions.a: Because those chalk marks showed that his luggage had already been examined and passed by the Customs, so he was free to leave. Without them he might have been stopped and searched again, so they were worth more than anything in the case.
questions.aZh: 因为那些粉笔记号表明他的行李已被海关检查并放行，他可以自由离开；没有记号他可能再次被拦下检查，所以它们比箱子里的任何东西都珍贵。
questions.hint: 结合课文最后一句 precious chalk marks 与全文“被怀疑—澄清—放行”的情节来理解

translation:
现在的海关官员往往相当宽容。
但是，当你通过绿色通道，没有任何东西需要申报时，他们仍可以拦住你。
甚至是最诚实的人也常弄得觉得有罪似的，而老练的职业走私犯却使手提箱里藏着500只金表，却也处之泰然。
最近一次，我也出国归来，碰上一位特别好管闲事的年轻海关官员，他显然把我当成走私犯。
“您有什么需要申报的吗？
”他直盯着我的眼睛问。
“没有。
”我自信地回答说。
“请打开这只手提箱好吗？
”“好的。
”我回答说。
那位官员十分仔细地把箱子检查了一遍。
所有细心包装好的东西一会儿工夫就乱成一团。
我相信那箱子再也关不上了。
突然，我看到官员脸上露出了得意的神色。
他在我的箱底发现了一只小瓶，高兴地一把抓了起来。
“香水，嗯？
”他讥讽地说道，“你刚才应该申报，香水要上进口税的。
”“不，这不是香水，”我说，“是发胶。
”接着我脸带微笑补充说：“这是一种我自己配制的奇特的混合物。
”“你就闻一闻吧！
”我催促说。
海关官员拧开瓶盖，把瓶子放到鼻子底下。
一股怪味袭来，使他相信了我说的真话。
几分钟后，我终于被放行，手提划着宝贵的粉笔记号的行李，匆匆离去。
title: Not Guilty
subtitle: 无罪

lead.question: 海关官员为什么把“我”当成走私犯？“我”又是怎样证明自己无罪的？
lead.warmup: 你刚从国外旅行回来，提着行李走过机场的绿色通道。一位年轻的海关官员忽然叫住你，盯着你的眼睛问：“您有什么需要申报的吗？”你自信地回答“没有”，他却请你打开箱子。箱子被翻得乱七八糟，他在箱底发现一只小瓶，得意地说：“香水，嗯？”——换成你，会怎样证明自己无罪？
goals: 掌握 tolerant、declare、guilty、officious、pounce、exempt、import duty、nostril 等本课核心词汇
掌握 should have done 表示“本该做而未做”的含义和用法
熟悉 Would you mind doing…? 的礼貌请求及其答语 Not at all
能读懂绿色通道（the Green Channel）与海关申报的真实情境，并用英语复述故事梗概
lead.summary: 本课写作者回国过海关的一段经历。海关官员虽然宽容，却仍可在绿色通道拦住没有东西申报的旅客，让诚实的人也觉得自己有罪。一位好管闲事的年轻官员把作者当成走私犯，把箱子翻得乱七八糟，并在箱底搜出一只小瓶，认定是香水，指责他早该申报。作者说明那是自己配制的发胶，请他闻一闻；一股怪味使官员相信了真话，作者终于带着箱上宝贵的粉笔记号匆匆离去。
lead.tips: 注意区分“过去该做而未做”与“现在该做”：责备或惋惜过去用 should have done（You should have declared that.），不能用来谈现在的事；回答 Would you mind…? 时，同意帮忙要说 Not at all. / Of course not.，说 Yes 反而是拒绝。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我没有任何东西需要申报，于是径直走了绿色通道。
exercises.a: I had nothing to declare, so I went straight through the Green Channel.

exercises.q: 句型转换：把直接引语改成间接引语——“Have you anything to declare?” he asked.
exercises.a: He asked (me) whether/if I had anything to declare.

exercises.q: 填空：Customs officers are quite ______ these days, but even really honest people are often made to feel ______.
exercises.note: be made to do 表示被迫做

exercises.q: 改错：找出并改正下面句中的错误——“You should declare that,” he said sarcastically.
exercises.a: “You should have declared that,” he said sarcastically.
exercises.note: should have done 本该做而未做

exercises.q: 汉译英：那位官员仔细检查了我的手提箱，我尴尬地站在一旁。
exercises.a: The officer conducted a careful search of my case, and I stood by awkwardly.
exercises.note: conduct 进行、实施；awkwardly 尴尬地

exercises.q: 汉译英：他的怀疑被驳回了，后来他因态度粗鲁而受到训斥。
exercises.a: His suspicion was dismissed, and later he was reprimanded for his rudeness.

exercises.q: 填空并改写：① It is the ______ for travellers with nothing to declare to go through the Green Channel.（习俗）② 把 Have you anything to declare? 改成否定疑问句。
exercises.a: ① custom ② Haven't you anything to declare? / Don't you have anything to declare?

quiz.q: 课文说，如今海关官员相当宽容，但当你经绿色通道且没有东西申报时，他们仍可以怎样做？
The Green Channel 指的是机场里的哪种通道？
options: 供携带征税物品的旅客走的通道
供没有征税物品申报的旅客走的通道
供机组人员专用的通道
供外交人员专用的通道

quiz.q: “You should have declared that.” 这句话是什么意思？
options: 你现在必须申报那样东西
你本该申报那样东西，却没有申报
你最好不要申报那样东西
你申报那样东西是对的

quiz.q: Suddenly, I saw the Officer's face light up. 描写的是官员怎样的神情？
options: 因有所发现而露出得意、兴奋的神色
quiz.note: light up 露出得意神色

quiz.q: Perfume is not exempt from import duty. 的意思是？
options: 香水必须申报但可以免税
香水要缴进口税，不能豁免

quiz.q: An unpleasant smell which convinced him that I was telling the truth. 句中 convinced 的含义是？
quiz.note: convince sb. that 使某人相信
